code:
-- EXISTS
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ... WHERE sod.ProductID = p.ProductID)

-- IN
WHERE p.ProductID IN (SELECT sod.ProductID FROM ...)

-- JOIN — needs DISTINCT!
SELECT DISTINCT p.Name FROM Production.Product p
INNER JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail sod ON p.ProductID = sod.ProductID;
caption: "Which products have at least one order?" — three genuinely different execution paths.
